agent.notes: Envs rebuilt manually: bpy 3.6 is no longer on PyPI, so both venvs use Python 3.11 + bpy==4.4.0 (4.5.x deadlocks at interpreter exit, 4.2.0 segfaults); the project's requires-python==3.10 pin blocks installing it, so its source is put on sys.path via a .pth file (src untouched); X11/GL system libs installed. The workload builds a VRM0 armature plus a 24x16 UV sphere with 3 shape keys and a non-MToon material, then exports VRM twice through ops.export_scene.vrm, which reaches the changed morph-normal code. The repo benchmark downloads a model, so it was not used. The digest is order-independent (sorted triangles of rounded attributes plus JSON) because the exporter's vertex order and float noise vary between runs even on base; flat shading is used for stability. An atexit handler saves coverage and calls os._exit so Blender's leak report doesn't follow the digest line. Base ~2.0s, head ~6.7s (per-vertex rescan of loop triangles). Coverage: head 86%, base 74%. Digests are equal.
